title: Parameter override
description: New API's param_override, as it is: paste one from New API and it works unchanged. It runs on every request an agent sends through the gateway, whichever provider serves it. Nothing happens while it is empty.
json.label: Override (JSON)
json.hint: Either keys to set as they are, {"temperature": 0.2}, or {"operations": [...]} run in order. A path is gjson's (a.b.0, messages.-1, tools.*.name). Modes: set, delete, move, copy, prepend, append, trim_prefix, trim_suffix, ensure_prefix, ensure_suffix, trim_space, to_lower, to_upper, replace, regex_replace, return_error, prune_objects. Conditions look in the body first, then in model, request_path, protocol, agent and stream. Changes are saved as you type, once the JSON is valid.
error.json: Not saved, this is not valid JSON: {message}
error.object: Not saved: the override must be a JSON object, {…}.
example.label: An example
example.hint: Caps max_tokens at 32000 and drops temperature for models whose name contains "reasoner". Replaces what is in the editor.
